meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要向团队讲解代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to others

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能把 GitHub 的代码变更(PR)变成讲解视频:读取该 PR 的差异、提交和文件,规划脚本与画面,最终生成 mp4。过程自动分步,产出脚本、画面帧和视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或在检出仓库里说“这个 PR”,并要求做成讲解视频时触发。只处理代码变更,不用于产品宣传或无 PR 的选题;不确定时走 /hyperframes 分流。

say.text: 把 github.com/foo/bar/pull/1 做成讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会读取该 PR 并分步生成视频。

say.text: 给 foo/bar#7 做短视频,讲清修了什么 bug。
say.note: 按修复讲解流程生成脚本和成片。

say.text: 把当前仓库里这个 PR 做成视频,说明重构逻辑。
say.note: 识别当前 PR,按重构讲解路线生成。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a GitHub PR (URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checkout) into an mp4 explainer: it reads the diff/commits/files, drafts a storyboard and script, and renders frames to a final video, in a step-by-step workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered by a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo when a code-change explainer video is requested. Not for product promos or PR-less topics; unclear cases go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make an explainer video from github.com/foo/bar/pull/1.
say_en.note: It reads the PR and builds the video step by step.

say_en.text: Make a short video for foo/bar#7 explaining the bug fix.
say_en.note: It follows the fix-explainer flow for script and render.

say_en.text: Turn this PR in the current repo into a refactor walkthrough video.
say_en.note: Detects the current PR and uses the refactor route.
